glassmorphism_rules.blur_instruction: Use expo-blur `BlurView` with tint='dark' and intensity={30} as the absolute background of cards

home_dashboard.layout_rules: Bento grid style using Flexbox. 'Steps' should be a wide feature card spanning full width. 'Calories' and 'Water' should sit side-by-side below it. Place subtle, absolute-positioned blurry blobs (gradient_glow_primary & secondary) behind the cards to create the requested blue/purple gradient look without making it look cheap.

activity_screen.layout_rules: Vertical list of wide glassmorphism cards. Each card must feature a distinct activity icon (Lucide) and a glowing progress bar (use expo-linear-gradient for the bar fill).

diet_screen.layout_rules: Vertical list of image-backed glass cards. Use the provided diet_ images. Images must have a dark gradient overlay (e.g., linear gradient from transparent to rgba(0,0,0,0.9)) so the white text and macro breakdowns at the bottom of the card remain highly legible (WCAG APCA compliant).

profile_screen.layout_rules: Center aligned circular profile picture with a subtle border. Bold name below. User stats (height, weight, goal) in a small horizontal flex row. Below that, a settings-style list (Account, Goals, Notifications) using flat, full-width glass rows with right-chevrons.

profile_avatar.description: Athletic man portrait for profile screen

diet_breakfast.description: Oats and berries for breakfast card background

diet_lunch.description: Healthy chicken salad for lunch card background

diet_dinner.description: Healthy salmon plate for dinner card background

technical_instructions_for_main_agent: Since this is a React Native (Expo) app, DO NOT attempt to use HTML/CSS elements like 'div' or 'span'. Use standard RN components: View, Text, ScrollView, Image, etc.
Implement the UI using either NativeWind (if you prefer Tailwind) or standard StyleSheet.create().

For the requested 'blue/purple gradient', DO NOT use a single flat linear gradient background for the whole app. Instead, set the main background to deep dark (#05050A) and position large, blurred absolute Views with primary and secondary glow colors behind the main content. This creates a high-end ambient 'Crystal Glass' effect rather than a cheap UI look.
Use `expo-blur` for all glassmorphism cards. Ensure they have a 1px `rgba(255,255,255,0.1)` border. Do not make them fully transparent.
Use `@react-navigation/bottom-tabs` for navigation. The bottom tab bar should also have a BlurView background to match the glassmorphism aesthetic.
CRITICAL: Add `testID` attributes to all interactive and key informational elements (e.g., `testID='steps-card'`, `testID='profile-avatar'`, etc.) for testing.
